title: Sports Day & Gana Homa 🏃‍♂️🔥
writeup: The morning belonged to Bappa's little champions! Kids from the galli battled it out in Running Race, Lemon Spoon, Balloon Jump and a surprise game — pure energy, laughter and community spirit filled the streets. As evening fell, the mood turned devotional with a sacred Gana Homa and Satyanarayan Pooja, the mandap filling with chants and rising smoke as the community gathered in prayer. A full day of celebration, from playful mornings to peaceful evenings. 🙏
